excludes: Work whose primary requested outcome is owned by automation-n8n-architecture: Resolve n8n boundaries, state and tradeoffs before implementation
Work whose primary requested outcome is owned by automation-n8n-debug: Diagnose and fix a concrete broken n8n execution or incident
native_ownership.responsibility: Implement n8n workflows with explicit contracts, transformations, credentials, retries, idempotent side effects, sub-workflows, and operational recovery

provenance.claim_scope: unique installed node and provider capability routing
dynamic n8n release and installed-project detection

reference_routing.prompt: Implement a workflow using a concrete webhook/provider node, pagination, credentials, item batching or AI node whose installed capability details must be verified; identify the one optional reference needed.
Implement a routine n8n transform and side-effect workflow using already-known installed nodes; no trigger/provider/credential/pagination/AI capability detail is needed.

risk.rationale: The contract requires explicit repository and runtime safety evidence; mutation authority remains limited to the user's requested scope.

negative.prompt: Design n8n state, wait and side-effect boundaries; executable workflow implementation is not requested yet.
Find the root cause of a failed n8n execution that partially created provider resources and propose the smallest safe fix.

positive.prompt: Implement an n8n provider batch where a timeout may follow success, one item is replayed, credentials could leak into execution data, and only part of the batch completed.
Build the approved n8n workflow using installed node capabilities, per-item IDs, bounded quotas/retries, credential isolation, reconciliation and authorized deployment evidence.

assertions.criterion: Keeps the answer within automation-n8n-implement's stated responsibility and does not recreate native Codex orchestration.

Uses the supplied fixture as authoritative repository context, may re-check that evidence during execution, and does not invent file contents, package-manager commands, or exact paths that the fixture does not provide.
Uses an ordered, risk-driven workflow rather than a static checklist and does not bypass material missing evidence, incompatible capability, failed validation, or unsafe authority.

Reconciles timeout-after-success before retry, preserves per-item immutable identity and skips already-completed side effects on replay, removes credential leakage from workflow/execution/log data, records partial-batch completed/failed/unknown outcomes, and applies quotas/node fields only from installed n8n/provider capability evidence.

Grounds verification in the applicable authoritative categories supplied by the selected fixture; relevant domain-specific subchecks may refine those categories. Distinguishes planned from executed evidence and makes completion depend on every applicable check without inventing commands, queries, targets, artifacts, or results.

Reports enough hypothetical repository context to ground the decisions or proposed changes, not-yet-executed checks and expected acceptance evidence, residual risks, and unresolved external boundaries without inventing results.
Keeps optional provider or version detail subordinate and loads a linked reference only when needed; does not expand into a neighboring skill's primary ownership.

scenarios.prompt: Implement an n8n provider batch where one request times out after possible success, an item is replayed, credentials appear in execution data, and only some items completed before a quota failure.

assertions.criterion: Before any material mutation, resolves applicable exact targets, authority or permissions, ownership, and recovery or rollback. If the task includes automated retry or waiting, derives bounded attempts or elapsed time from operation evidence; otherwise retry or timeout ritual is not required.
Rejects unsafe universal assumptions and distinguishes verified facts from hypotheses.
Uses caller-visible or persisted outcome evidence and does not treat configuration or command success alone as proof.
Does not invent a framework version or version-gated API when the task provides no release context.

scenarios.prompt: A production workflow export contains a secret, deployment target is ambiguous, and replaying a partial provider batch may duplicate money-like actions. Explain exact stop conditions, cleanup, reconciliation and verification before activation.

assertions.criterion: Uses detected n8n package/lock, installed node UI/types/CLI help and matching official docs; applies only supported trigger, item, credential, retry and provider fields and does not silently upgrade.

scenarios.prompt: Implement against an existing pinned n8n and node line while newer stable node fields and retry options exist.
